from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u073/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); lines=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
            while q:
                x,y=q.pop(); comp.append((x,y))
                for a,b in ((x-1,y),(x+1,y),(x,y-1),(x,y+1)):
                    if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and (a,b) not in seen and grid[a][b] != bg:
                        seen.add((a,b)); q.append((a,b))
            if len(comp)==3:
                rs={x for x,y in comp}; cs={y for x,y in comp}
                if len(rs)==1 or len(cs)==1:
                    comp.sort()
                    lines.append(comp)
    # The three-cell connected line is the stamp; its middle cell is the anchor.
    stamp=max(lines, key=lambda p: sum(grid[x][y] != bg for x,y in p))
    vals=[grid[x][y] for x,y in stamp]
    vertical=len({x for x,y in stamp})==3
    anchor=stamp[1]
    stamp_colors=set(vals)
    # Isolated cells of the remaining foreground color mark stamp centers.
    candidates=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v=grid[r][c]
            if v==bg or v in stamp_colors: continue
            # avoid selecting cells joined to other non-background cells
            if all(not(0<=r+dr<h and 0<=c+dc<w and grid[r+dr][c+dc]!=bg) for dr,dc in ((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1))):
                candidates.append((r,c,v))
    marker=Counter(v for r,c,v in candidates).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c,v in candidates:
        if v != marker: continue
        for i,color in enumerate(vals):
            dr=i-1 if vertical else 0
            dc=0 if vertical else i-1
            a,b=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w: out[a][b]=color
    return out
'''
p=programs/'task-ff293dc5.py'; p.write_text(code)
